description: Search TMDB movies by title; returns compact summaries with the TMDB id that the other movie tools (get_movie, get_movie_credits, …) require, plus pagination info. Use this over search_multi when you already know the result is a movie. `region` here only picks which country's release_date is shown per result (e.g. a title's US vs. India theatrical date) — verified live, it does not filter which movies match or reorder them; for actual region-based availability use get_watch_providers instead.

exact_year.description: Match `year` against the original (primary) release year only, dropping every movie first released in another year. Requires `year`.

include_adult.description: Include adult (NSFW) results. Defaults to false.

language.description: Override the response language (ISO-639-1, optionally with a region), e.g. 'ru-RU' or 'en-US'. Localizes titles/overviews/genre names. Defaults to the server's TMDB_LANGUAGE. A well-formed code TMDB has no translation for (e.g. 'xx') is not an error: overviews come back null, movies/shows keep their original-language title, and episodes get a generic 'Episode N' name.

page.description: 1-based page number for pagination (TMDB returns up to 20 results per page, max 500).

region.description: ISO-3166-1 country code for region-specific results (default 'US').

year.description: Bias results toward this release year. Soft by default: it matches any of a movie's release dates, so re-releases and older films still appear (verified live: 'alien' with year 2003 ranks the 1979 Alien first). Set exact_year to match only the original release year.

name: search_movies

vote_average.description: TMDB's own 0-10 user score. A different audience and scale from the IMDb/RT/Metacritic scores get_movie/get_tv return as `ratings` — don't compare, average or substitute across the two.

title: Search movies
